bounded_conclusions: The independently qualified negative E4 B3 corrector slope is admissible in the same strong-response B3/K=0.1 live-MODFLOW case.
It converges to the same accepted physical state and ledger as CURRENT_PLUS_U within the preregistered gates.
It uses the same three coupling outer iterations as CURRENT_PLUS_U in this case, so MAP05A provides no performance advantage claim.
MAP05 remains falsified independently because INTERCEPT_ONLY encountered a structured corrector trial failure.
Together MAP05 and MAP05A show that accepted physics can be invariant between two nonzero slope policies while path robustness still depends on slope policy.
